scope: Selected source-linked research connections; not an exhaustive corpus or independent proof audit. AI attribution and each stated limitation remain attached to the underlying sources.

connections.external_question: Joshi–Rust Conjecture 3.8: three first occurrences of maximum Thue–Morse monochromatic arithmetic progressions
connections.enables: Compute the earliest starts by exact formulas and classify all maximum starts in two families, without searching to an arbitrary cutoff.
connections.missing_bridge: Independent specialist semantic/proof assessment and current prior-art reconciliation; plus-family exponent 1 is excluded.
connections.acceptance_test: Match Run, FirstMaximum, digit parity and attained A/i semantics to the paper on all three admitted parameter families; preserve the exact seven-module receipt.
connections.label: Thue–Morse first occurrences

connections.external_question: Frid–Laborde–Peltomäki Conjecture 17 in arXiv v2 / Conjecture 2 in the published paper
connections.enables: Rules out a finite binary automaton for the difference sequence and a 2-regular representation for prefix palindromic length.
connections.missing_bridge: Independent specialist review of the hand argument and exact universal tiling encoding; no Lean claim.
connections.acceptance_test: Verify the diagonal gate, separating prefixes and complete reachable-state inclusion; a resource safeguard failure must never count as a proof.
connections.label: Period-doubling palindromic length

connections.external_question: Which model restrictions make energy-to-reflection-visibility inference uniformly robust?
connections.enables: Distinguishes a positive target margin from positive separation in the measured curves, directing bounded-class or extra-measurement design.
connections.missing_bridge: Authenticate contacts and disorder admission in the motivating learning model; no average-case or experimental inference.
connections.acceptance_test: Verify one fixed potential per device across the entire sweep, same leads, zero dissipation and admitted unbounded finite barriers; preserve the Appendix II length exclusion.
connections.label: Nanowire energy and visibility

connections.external_question: Holtgrefe et al. Section 6: original NANUQ metric on level-2 OLP galled networks and level-3 bloblets
connections.enables: Circular decomposition and exact displayed-tree split support in the admitted all-finite-level class.
connections.missing_bridge: Full structural admission, adjacent-copy representation and multi-blob composition review; weighted quartet prior is not the original distinct-topology metric.
connections.acceptance_test: Compare Definitions 2.2–2.4 and the Section 6 source class to every structural hypothesis and metric normalization in Theorem A.
connections.label: All-level NANUQ support

connections.external_question: Identifiability of numerical introgression parameters from same-genealogy short-locus sequence laws
connections.enables: Nine literal moments suffice to distinguish the admitted nine numerical parameters, including equal-rate cases.
connections.missing_bridge: Full scheduled-process/observation bridge, independent biological review and practical finite-data inverse; topology and direction are supplied.
connections.acceptance_test: Keep two phased copies per species, two homologous sites sharing one genealogy, known JC scale, strict times and rate ties; separate analytic injectivity checking from process semantics.
connections.label: Two-site MSci identification

connections.external_question: Restrictions on positive nonperiodic Collatz valuation itineraries
connections.enables: Exclude the retained two-block Thue–Morse coding class from unbounded positive orbits under the theorem's exact assumptions.
connections.missing_bridge: No reduction of arbitrary orbits to this code family; other cycles and nonperiodic itineraries remain outside it.
connections.acceptance_test: Use the fully accelerated odd map, positive finite block valuations and one actual positive odd start; preserve the periodic exception.
connections.label: Fixed Thue–Morse Collatz valuations

connections.external_question: Effective identity, relaxed compact decision and exact real-exponential first-order theory
connections.enables: A degree-based finite rational witness grid for nonnested polynomial-exponential nonidentity and guarded compact delta decisions.
connections.missing_bridge: Real Schanuel remains a premise for arbitrary exact nested first-order decision; no unconditional resolution is supplied.
connections.acceptance_test: Retain full exponent polynomials as grouping keys, a nonempty open box, explicit algebraic coefficients and guarded partial-term semantics; do not substitute identity for root existence.
connections.label: Polynomial–exponential identity

connections.external_question: Copy complexity of testing two unknown interacting local Gibbs states
connections.enables: Turn a prior-uniform squared-Bures Bayes-risk estimate into a finite minimax/off-net two-source testing guarantee with an explicit copy budget.
connections.missing_bridge: The risk constant must be uniform in size, finite candidate set and prior; the retained source does not supply this interacting-Gibbs theorem.
connections.acceptance_test: Use exactly n copies from each source, charge 2n total, retain finite-precision slack and distinguish known-reference certification from two-unknown testing.
connections.label: Gibbs testing conversion

connections.external_question: Finite positive support recovery through a faithful observation-to-moment interface
connections.enables: Reuse exact positive sparse-moment determination in compatible identification tasks without rederiving the classical theorem.
connections.missing_bridge: Each new scientific receiver must prove a single fixed pushforward law, grouped equal values and positive masses.
connections.acceptance_test: Match the exact four-module certificate scope and source law; prove the typed adapter rather than infer it from matching terminology.
connections.label: Positive finite moments
